core_meaning.primary_meaning: Esmaeel is a Hebrew-origin name meaning “An. The source record”.
core_meaning.literal_meaning: The name is the Hebrew word itself, used unchanged as a given name rather than a derived or diminutive form.
core_meaning.meaning_explanation: Esmaeel corresponds to the Hebrew form إسماعيل (Hebrew יִשְׁמָעֵאל). Its core sense is god hears, god is hearing. Ismāʿīl, the Arabic form of Ishmael, a prophet named in the Qur'an. The source record's gloss 'God hearing' is a reasonable rendering.
